news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.52 (vs ₹1.48 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.52 (up from ₹1.48 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹245.7m (up 354% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹7.82m (up 71% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 3.2% (down from 8.5% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 49% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 82% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.13 (vs ₹0.61 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.13 (up from ₹0.61 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹89.0m (up 417% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.50m (up 86% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.9% (down from 11% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 57% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 75% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
